Toll fares increase on Bengaluru's NICE Road and highways

Toll fares for the NICE Road, Electronic City flyover, and Attibele highway in Bengaluru have been revised and increased starting today. The specific new rates have been published by the relevant authorities. This change impacts daily commuters and transportation costs in the region.
